infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Alfred listens only while you're speaking to it, and sends what you say to your own Mac to answer. Nothing is recorded or stored on this phone.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Attach photos for Alfred to remember, or bottle photos for your medicine schedule. They're sent to your Mac and stored there.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Pictures you take during a recording are also saved to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan a claim code to link this phone, photograph medicine bottles, or capture slides while recording a note.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Alfred looks for your Mac on your local network first, so your conversation never leaves the house when it doesn't have to.
